dag.description: Pre-staged-data variant of the minimal PyTorch train-to-registration flow: DummyDataLoading supplies a pre-built/uploaded dataset (the MDS manifest build path) instead of a live Cradle query, followed by tabular preprocessing, PyTorch training, Package, Payload, and Registration - no evaluation or calibration stage.

agent_context.when_to_use: Same minimal PyTorch train-to-registration flow as pytorch_train_register_e2e, but training data is supplied by DummyDataLoading from a pre-built/uploaded dataset or manifest (the MDS build path) instead of a live Cradle query. Use for local/offline reproducible builds or when the dataset is materialized ahead of time. Used by seller_grading (SellerGradingImageValidation, mds NA build path).
agent_context.when_not_to_use: Use pytorch_train_register_e2e when training data should be loaded from Cradle at pipeline time. Use standard_e2e / complete_e2e / pytorch_percentile_e2e if evaluation or calibration is required before registration.
differentiators: Dummy / pre-staged data-loading twin of pytorch_train_register_e2e (DummyDataLoading replaces CradleDataLoading_training)
No Cradle dependency - data comes from a pre-built manifest / upload (MDS path)
Minimal 6-node train-to-registration flow, no eval and no calibration

prerequisites.check: Pre-staged training dataset/manifest available to DummyDataLoading
prerequisites.how: MDS / manifest or uploaded dataset path configured in DummyDataLoadingConfig

safe_defaults: no calibration or eval steps to configure
common_pitfalls: The data-loading node is bare 'DummyDataLoading' with no job_type suffix - match the config key exactly
Pre-staged data must already be compatible with TabularPreprocessing_training
No offline metrics are produced - validate model quality separately
